scope: All twelve public main revisions pinned together at 2026-10-01T22:44:02.472972+00:00, with the vocabulary census, subsets, repository statistics and site audit regenerated at those pins. Card sources are published browsers, CultureMech's generated README inventory and DUFMech's frozen seed-family JSON. DUF seed families remain explicitly distinguished from curated mechanism records. Licensing labels follow the user-requested CC BY 4.0 data / BSD-3-Clause code policy; this audit does not infer that policy from the older repository license files.
